children: Fomo co-founder Se Yong Park denied rumors that the team is preparing to launch its own Launchpad on Solana. According to Foresight News, Park said the team believes there are already too many tokens on the market and has no intention of adding more, preferring instead to support the growth of strong communities.

title: Fomo Co-Founder Denies Plans to Launch a Launchpad on Solana
